verification.detail: Quoted observation appeared in source extraction and a separate reread. Both use the same model; this is consistency evidence, not independent proof.

limitations: Internal blind observer inspected source frames at integer seconds 0 through 7. Interval boundaries are sample boundaries, not frame-accurate measurements.
No audio playback was inspected. The source fixture has a silent audio track.
Visual sampling can miss brief events. Model transcript timestamps are approximate.
The extraction and blind reread use the same model and can share errors.
Appearance-only defects are withheld until stronger verification is available.
